description: Enhanced boundary coverage for schema file selection: glob-pattern removal from the build, classifying multiple files as non-schema content via none, and explicitly including several external SQL files alongside a local table.

sql_files.Keep.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Keep]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)
sql_files.OldTableA.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[OldTableA]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)
sql_files.OldTableB.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[OldTableB]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=0
package_exists=true
tables=[dbo].[Keep]
views=
pre_deploy_script=false
post_deploy_script=false
diagnostics=none

sql_files.Main.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Main]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)
sql_files.NotesA.sql:
-- excluded as non-schema content
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[NotesA]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)
sql_files.NotesB.sql:
-- excluded as non-schema content
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[NotesB]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=0
package_exists=true
tables=[dbo].[Main]
views=
pre_deploy_script=false
post_deploy_script=false
diagnostics=none

sql_files.Local.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Local]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)

external_sql_files.ext1.sql: CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ExtOne] ( C1 INT NOT NULL )
external_sql_files.ext2.sql: CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ExtTwo] ( C1 INT NOT NULL )

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=0
package_exists=true
tables=[dbo].[ExtOne],[dbo].[ExtTwo],[dbo].[Local]
views=
pre_deploy_script=false
post_deploy_script=false
diagnostics=none
